newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products look steady to firm, except fuel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products look steady to firm, except fuel.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to touch firmer on Wednesday except for easier fuel, traders said.
Gas oil preimums were unchanged to slightly firmer, as Feb IPE gas oil gained over $2 a tonne.
High and low sulphur fuel oil eased again amid continuing signs of good supply.
Gasoline was a touch firmer, gaining $1 or so on steadier crude, but the market was marking time.
Naphtha also looked stronger by $1 or so with crude, consolidating after recent losses.
